=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text t1 " queens: "
text t2 " solutions\n"
global cols uchar 8
global d1 uchar 15
global d2 uchar 15
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note counts placements for rows r .. n-1; d1 holds the r+c diagonals, d2 the r-c+7 ones
fn place r ulong n ulong to ulong
if eq r n
ret 1
end
cnt = ulong 0
for c ulong n
a = add r c
b = add r sub 7 c
if eq get cols c 0
if eq get d1 a 0
if eq get d2 b 0
put cols c 1
put d1 a 1
put d2 b 1
cnt = add cnt place add r 1 n
put cols c 0
put d1 a 0
put d2 b 0
end
end
end
end
ret cnt
end
fn main to int
for i ulong 8
n = add i 1
emitu n
emit t1
emitu place 0 n
emit t2
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
1 queens: 1 solutions
2 queens: 0 solutions
3 queens: 0 solutions
4 queens: 2 solutions
5 queens: 10 solutions
6 queens: 4 solutions
7 queens: 40 solutions
8 queens: 92 solutions
</pre>
